message: Root scoped self-review while T-004 is active: azure_local.prepare_local currently accepts only actual == examples/private-vm.arm.json. This makes the shipped example a production allowlist and rejects every other valid Bicep graph; it is hardcoding to the fixture and narrows the approved Bicep routing/preparation scope without authorization. Replace exact example equality with substantive Azure-specific validation of the compiled resource graph/parameters against declared ownership, private networking, identity, monitoring, backup and allowed resource policy. It need not be a general ARM interpreter or neutral engine: supported expressions/structures can be explicitly bounded and unknown ones blocked, but ordinary equivalent Bicep variants (different symbols/order/comments/modular structure and permitted resource names/settings) must work. Add a real independently varied private VM/module case that compiles and passes, plus meaningful compiled public-IP/ingress/destructive-existing-resource negatives. Preserve exact compiled bytes in the lock. Do not weaken required checks or silently broaden policy. Record this implementation correction in your own evidence/report, not a fabricated independent verdict. Continue the same task/context; shared contracts/auth files remain read-only while root handles their separate review.
